# Robot Learning Tutorial

This directory contains theoretical and practical guides related to robot learning, covering robot intelligent decision-making methods such as reinforcement learning and imitation learning.

Existing demo: Multiple robots for moving furniture

## Learning Path
1. Master the fundamentals of machine learning (such as supervised learning, unsupervised learning)
2. Understand the basic principles of reinforcement learning (such as Markov decision processes, policy gradients, etc.)
3. Learn deep learning frameworks (such as PyTorch, TensorFlow)
4. Practice robot learning algorithms (starting with simple tasks)
5. Explore cutting-edge research directions (such as meta-learning, multi-agent learning, etc.)

## Recommended Tools and Frameworks
- Python 3.8+
- PyTorch/TensorFlow
- Gym/MuJoCo
- RLlib/Stable Baselines
- Robot simulation environments (such as our simulation series experiments)
